groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: unlocked from the Venus-to-Mercury Junction; gives the Incubator Segment

conditions: On a first playthrough the quest's egg step has a 100% drop from the first den and a 60-second first incubation; that first hatch is still random and may not be Sahasa.
Consigning an unwanted pet to the Lotus for 25,000 credits is the only way to free a full slot.

groups.activity: Capture; break Kubrow Dens on Grineer Forest tiles

rows.label: Kubrow Egg
rows.note: wiki estimates 4-5 runs; reports of 30+ are common

conditions: Run to the dens, break them, capture and extract, or abort quickly if nothing dropped.
You can hold more than one egg at a time.
bonuses: A range-stacked Xaku casting The Vast Untime clears every den in a room, including ones you can't see, while passively picking up Mantle's Neurodes.
Scanning dens with a Codex scanner makes completed ones glow and show through walls, which speeds up finding them (unconfirmed).

conditions: The first core is free from the Venus-to-Mercury Junction (Vox Solaris); after that, buy the reusable blueprint for 50,000 credits and build another for each attempt.
A wrong Random Incubation result consumes another core as well as another egg.
Argon Crystal decays at daily reset, so pick it up last and build the core right away.

rows.label: Sahasa Kubrow
rows.note: random result among Huras, Raksa, Sahasa, Sunika, Chesa
rows.alt: use two Sahasa Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Random Incubation cannot be directed to Sahasa; a wrong breed has no pity protection and starts another egg-and-core attempt.
Two matching Sahasa imprints replace the breed roulette but do not replace the egg or Power Core.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 hours with the separate Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment; rushing costs platinum.
You can't cancel an incubation once started.
bonuses: Sahasa imprints are tradeable. A mature kubrow can give 2, 1.5h each; the Genetic Code Template blueprint is 50,000 credits, reusable, or 15 platinum built.
Mature it instantly at the Incubator once hatched, then level straight to 30 for the Mastery; there is no gild-and-relevel cycle like a modular pet.

disclosures.title: the safer route once anyone you know has one
disclosures.body: Rolling random eggs over and over hoping for Sahasa is the way people get burned: posts of 4-7 duplicates of the wrong breed aren't rare, and the wiki documents no pity system. Two Sahasa imprints from a friend or trade chat make the outcome close to deterministic, at the same egg-and-core cost as one random attempt.
